//: Used in: components/billing/SettleBalanceSheet (settleBalanceSheet namespace). Pay off a negative available balance. A balance goes negative EITHER because a share reward cost more than the credits covered (E069: the customer is always paid in full) OR because a PAYG card charge could not be collected, so the copy must not name only the card. Voice: 'share' not 'post'; plain punctuation, no em dashes.
title: Settle your balance
intro: A share reward was paid out that your balance didn't cover, so it's negative. Pay it off to clear your account and lift the block.
amountNote: Double-check the amount in the payment sheet. It may differ if your balance changed since this screen loaded.
failedBody: Your payment didn't go through. Please try again.
alreadySettledBody: Your balance is already settled. It may have been paid from another device.
verifyingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.
successBody: We charged {{amount}}. Your balance is back to zero.
unverifiedTitle: We couldn't verify your payment yet
unverifiedBody: If it went through, your balance will update shortly and we'll let you know.
